title: Golden Award White Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup (125 mL) vegetable oil or shortening
9 1/2 - 10 1/2 cups (2375-2625 mL) Golden Award All Purpose Flour
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let stand 10 minutes.
Measure warm water into a large mixing bowl; add sugar, oil and salt. Add yeast mixture and mix well. Stir in sufficient flour to make a soft, workable dough.

Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface; knead 10-15 minutes until dough is smooth and elastic. Form dough into a ball and place in greased bowl, turning once to grease the top. Cover and let rise 50 minutes or until doubled.
Punch down and shape into 4 round balls. Cover and let rest 20 minutes. Form into loaves and place in greased 1.5 L (8 1/2" x 4 1/2") loaf pans. Brush tops with oil. Cover and let rise 50-55 minutes.
Bake in 190°C (375°F) oven 35-40 minutes or until bread tests done. Remove from pans and cool on wire rack.

title: Choc. Chip Banana Muffins
directions: Mix tog. 1st 3 ingred. of dry mixture. Stir in choc. chips.
Cream tog. butter, sugar with electric mixer. Beat in eggs one at a time.
Mash bananas & add with vanilla to moist mixture. Add moist mixture to dry - all at once.
Stir until batter is moist but still lumpy.
Fill 12 muffin cups 3/4 full of batter.
Bake 25 min @ 350°.
notes: NB 2 lg or 3 med bananas = 1 cup.

title: Overnight buns (Mrs. Marg)
directions: Dissolve 1 tsp. sugar in 1/2 c lukewarm H2O. Add 1 pkg yeast. Set aside to rise - 10 min.
To 3 c lukewarm H2O add 1 c sugar, 1 tsp. salt, 3/4 c cooking oil, & 2 well beaten eggs. Add yeast mixture to this & beat & mix in 9-11 c. flour to make a stiff dough.

Put in greased bowl & grease top. Set in oven or warm place covered with tea towel. Start between 5 or 6 pm. Make into buns @ 10:30 or 11 pm. & let rise overnight - makes 2 cookie sheets & 1 1/2 dz cloves. (4 buns across x 5 rows).
Lightly rub butter or marg. over top of buns (use Crisco shortening on hands - pans) -
